---
title: "LISS panel grant award!"
date: 2026-02-13
categories: [Science, News, Social Networks, Survey Research]
---

Thrilled that we were awarded a LISS panel grant, with Rense Corten and Beate Völker! 

With the grant we can realize survey time in the LISS panel to measure (change in) extended networks that include both strong and weak ties. We apply a relatively new, yet well-established instrument: the network scale-up method (NSUM). Combined with the LISS panel, this offers unique possibilities to study causes and consequences of extended network size and its homogeneity to illuminate the social fabric of the Netherlands.

You can find some more info, also on super interesting other grants, [**here**](https://odissei-data.nl/project/variation-and-change-in-extended-networks/){target="_blank"}.
